system.description: When a hostile creature deals damage to you as a result of a melee attack, your Star Chakra lashes out attempting to irradiate everything in your immediate area. As a reaction, you can spend multiples of 2 Star Chakra, forcing the triggering creature to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the affected creature takes 2d6 poison damage and 1 rank of Weakened for every 2 Star Chakra spent.
